# Quiet Money

> The money rules nobody taught you. Short videos on money psychology and personal finance, each written out with its math and sources.

Educational content, not financial advice. Every number is computed; every story is sourced.

## Pages
- [Money Rules Library](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/): every video as a written page
- [Calculators](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/tools/): compound growth, credit card payoff, inflation
- [Free 7-day Money Reset](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/money-reset/): printable checklist
- [About](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/about/): what Quiet Money is and how videos are made

## Money rules
- [The Emergency Fund Myth That Destroys Finances](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-emergency-fund-myth-that-destroys-finances/): Why viewing your emergency fund as a wasted investment opens you up to high-interest debt spirals. Keep cash to protect your future.
- [Why Loss Aversion Triggers Panic Selling](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-loss-aversion-triggers-panic-selling/): Discover why loss aversion causes panic selling and learn the simple automation trick to protect your long-term investments from emotional decisions.
- [The $6,000 Credit Card Trap](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-6-000-credit-card-trap/): We break down how a $6,000 credit card balance at 24% APR costs over $10,000 in interest if you only pay the minimum. Learn the exact numbers and how paying a fixed amount clears the debt decades faster.
- [The Rule of 100: How to Land Your First Clients](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-rule-of-100-how-to-land-your-first-clients/): Learn the Rule of 100 framework to land your initial clients through pure consistency and volume. We break down the outreach math and the honest catches behind building active side income.
- [The Brutal Cost of Impressing Strangers](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-brutal-cost-of-impressing-strangers/): Status spending drains wealth through financed appearances and social pressure. Redirecting lifestyle inflation into quiet compounding creates true financial autonomy.
- [The Hidden $300,000 Car Trap](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-hidden-300-000-car-trap/): This script breaks down the hidden opportunity cost of a new car loan. By showing the difference between buying new every five years and investing the $500 monthly savings, it reveals how depreciation and interest compound into a massive lost fortune over 20 years.
- [When Paper Money Broke a Country](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/when-paper-money-broke-a-country/): The true story of John Law and the Mississippi Bubble shows how paper money manias destroy wealth when fundamentals vanish.
- [The Math of Leverage: How Debt Wipes People Out](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-math-of-leverage-how-debt-wipes-people-out/): Learn how 5x leverage turns a small 20% price gain into a 100% return, and how a 20% drop completely destroys your initial investment. Protect your downside by tracking your debt-to-asset ratio.
- [Why Penny Pinching Won't Make You Rich](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-penny-pinching-won-t-make-you-rich/): Penny pinching on small luxuries won't make you rich. Learn why scaling your income and investing heavily dwarfs any amount of coupon clipping.
- [Why the Last 10 Years Make You Rich](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-the-last-10-years-make-you-rich/): Compound interest acts like a rolling snowball: slow at the beginning, but unstoppable at the end. By investing $500 a month at an 8% return, over $1,000,000 of your total $1.7M balance is created in the final 10 years alone. Patience is where fortunes are built.
- [The 1932 Envelope Trick That Beats Budgeting Apps](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-1932-envelope-trick-that-beats-budgeting-apps/): The cash envelope system was a survival mechanism during the Great Depression. By bringing physical friction back to your spending digitally, you can stop card-based overspending for good.
- [Why You Abandon Your Best Money Ideas Too Soon](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-you-abandon-your-best-money-ideas-too-soon/): Learn why most beginners quit what's working too early. Using Alex Hormozi's 'More, Better, New' framework, we explain how focusing on one successful process and optimizing it can lead to massive long-term wealth.
- [The No-Spend Weekend That Actually Feels Fun](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-no-spend-weekend-that-actually-feels-fun/): Master the no-spend weekend with a simple 3-step action plan that makes keeping your cash easy and fun.
- [Why Your Cards Keep You Broke](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-your-cards-keep-you-broke/): Discover how credit cards and digital wallets bypass your brain's natural pain receptors, leading you to spend more. Learn how to manually reintroduce friction into your transactions to regain control over your money.
- [Why Skipping Your Daily Coffee Won't Make You Rich](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-skipping-your-daily-coffee-won-t-make-you-rich/): An analysis of the Latte Factor, showing why focusing on major expenses like housing and transportation yields far greater financial returns than cutting out small daily pleasures.
- [Why Another Course Won't Free You](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-another-course-won-t-free-you/): Information is not income. Here is why execution beats endless education and how to start building real assets today.
- [Stop Overdraft Fees With 3 Bank Alerts](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/stop-overdraft-fees-with-3-bank-alerts/): Stop losing money to overdraft fees. Turn on these three free bank alerts today to take back control of your cash flow.
- [The Timing Myth That Destroys Wealth](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-timing-myth-that-destroys-wealth/): Waiting to buy the dip feels smart, but missing the market's best days cuts long-term returns in half. Consistent investing and time in the market beat market timing every time.
- [The Subscription Creep Costing You Thousands](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-subscription-creep-costing-you-thousands/): Small recurring charges drain thousands over a decade. Learn the real math behind subscription creep and why you need to audit your monthly expenses today.
- [The Billion-Dollar Debt Trap](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-billion-dollar-debt-trap/): An analysis of good debt versus bad debt, using the math of financial leverage. While borrowing to buy assets can accelerate wealth, a small market drop can wipe out your entire investment.
- [How to Negotiate Your Bills in One 10-Minute Call](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/how-to-negotiate-your-bills-in-one-10-minute-call/): Learn the exact 3-step script to negotiate your phone or internet bill in under 15 minutes. By bypassing regular customer service and reaching the retention department with real competitor prices, you can claw back your cash.
- [The House Myth That Costs You Fortunes](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-house-myth-that-costs-you-fortunes/): Everyone says your home is your best investment. They're missing the maintenance, taxes, and opportunity cost that destroy your returns.
- [Why Your Brain Hates Your Future Self](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-your-brain-hates-your-future-self/): Present bias makes us favor instant gratification over long-term wealth. Learn how to trick your brain and protect your future self using automation.
- [The Billionaire Who Drove a 1993 Volvo](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-billionaire-who-drove-a-1993-volvo/): How IKEA founder Ingvar Kamprad turned extreme frugality into a massive competitive advantage and a retail empire.
- [Build a $1,000 Emergency Fund in 30 Days](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/build-a-1-000-emergency-fund-in-30-days/): Learn the exact 3-step blueprint to build a $1,000 starter emergency fund in 30 days using sell, cut, and side cash strategies.
- [Why Saving What's Left Keeps You Broke](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-saving-what-s-left-keeps-you-broke/): Why waiting until the end of the month to save guarantees you will stay broke, and the pay-yourself-first rule that changes everything.
- [Why the new car feeling fades in weeks](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-the-new-car-feeling-fades-in-weeks/): Learn why lifestyle upgrades fail to bring lasting happiness and how redirecting that cash can buy you true financial freedom.
- [The $500 Millionaire Math](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-500-millionaire-math/): Discover the exact compound interest math behind turning $500 a month into $1.7 million over 40 years at an 8% return.
- [Stop Selling Your Hours](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/stop-selling-your-hours/): Stop trading hours for dollars. Learn how to package your knowledge into a repeatable product and build true leverage.
- [How One Free Gift Bankrupted a Famous Philosopher](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/how-one-free-gift-bankrupted-a-famous-philosopher/): Learn how the Diderot Effect causes lifestyle inflation through a spiral of matching upgrades. By understanding this psychological bias, you can stop overspending and invest the difference.
- [The Slow Leak of Cash Under the Mattress](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-slow-leak-of-cash-under-the-mattress/): Discover how a steady 3% inflation rate strips away almost half of your buying power over 20 years. Learn why holding physical cash or keeping it in basic bank accounts is a guaranteed way to lose wealth, and why moving into assets is the only way to outrun the system.
- [The IRS Auditor Who Died With $22 Million](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-irs-auditor-who-died-with-22-million/): Discover the incredible story of IRS auditor Anne Scheiber, who turned a modest $5,000 nest egg into a $22 million fortune through patience, dividend reinvesting, and extreme frugality. Learn the money rules school never taught you.
- [Why Deal Flow Beats Any Salary](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-deal-flow-beats-any-salary/): Why big financial outcomes come from seeing many deals instead of relying on a single salary. Learn the mechanics of deal flow and the real catch behind it.
- [The Budgeting Rule That Lets You Spend Guilt-Free](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-budgeting-rule-that-lets-you-spend-guilt-free/): Learn the reverse budgeting strategy that lets you enjoy your money today while building wealth for tomorrow. No deprivation required.
- [The Hidden Cost of Your $5 Habit](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-hidden-cost-of-your-5-habit/): This video breaks down the compounding power of a $5 daily habit invested monthly over 30 years at an 8% return, proving that small amounts build serious wealth.
- [Why Earning $300M Wasn't Enough to Save Him](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-earning-300m-wasn-t-enough-to-save-him/): Mike Tyson's 2003 bankruptcy filing is a classic case study of how a massive income cannot survive without a financial defense system. Wealth isn't what you earn—it is what you keep.

- [The Side Income Math That Replaces Your Paycheck](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-side-income-math-that-replaces-your-paycheck/): Learn how an extra $1,000 a month from a side business, when invested consistently for 10 years, builds the foundation to eventually replace your primary paycheck.

- [Why your brain treats tax refunds like free money](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/why-your-brain-treats-tax-refunds-like-free-money/): Mental accounting makes us waste tax refunds and bonuses on things we'd never buy with regular salary. - [The 10-Year Delay That Costs $400,130](https://youngstunners88.github.io/quiet-money/rules/the-10-year-delay-that-costs-400-130/): This video breaks down the exact cost of waiting ten years to start investing.
